items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: The interviewee does not mention George Gano; the mention is made by the interviewer in a question about a third party (Piku).

ctx.x: Yeah. If he knew you was coming there, he already came with you.

He was on the way to George Gano. He said he had to be there. He was the one to take him some papers and try some numbers with him. So he was in a hurry to run over. He would have stopped there. Did Piku have many other pieces that he wrote that you know of in those days? Did he have many other numbers by him or was that the only one that you remember that he wrote?
Well, he rearranged a couple of records. No, the record come from me. He rearranged some records.
